description: Transfers the active phone call to another phone number. The transfer result can be retrieved using getTransferStatus after the transfer completes.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number to transfer the call to. The primary parameter for routing transfers.

timeout.description: Transfer timeout in seconds. Leave empty to use the configured default.

method.description: Transfer protocol. Leave empty or set to 'invite' for a standard blind transfer (the default behavior). Set to 'refer' to switch to SIP REFER.

continueCall.description: Whether the call continues after the transfer completes. Default: false — the caller is disconnected.

continueRecording.description: Whether call recording continues during the transfer. Default: true.

headers.description: Custom SIP headers as key-value pairs. Leave empty to send no extra headers.

output.description: No return value. Use getTransferStatus to retrieve the transfer result
